title: Token epoch attributor — observability probe for per-token timing & cache impact
creator: Anika Patel
description:
Goal: Add a low-overhead tracing and metrics probe that attributes per-token latency and inferred cost to inference requests, including explicit accounting for KV/cache hits and misses.

Background: Existing telemetry captures request-level latencies and sampled token traces, but we lack a compact, queryable artifact that maps emitted token slices to their contributing runtime factors (model computation, kv cache hit, kernel scheduling delay, batching wait). This ticket implements the Token Epoch Attributor (TEA) — a lightweight span/metric shim that emits structured token-attribution events to the metrics/log pipeline and populates a short ledger usable by dashboards and billing analytics.

Scope:
- Instrument runtime to emit per-token epoch records: token_index, request_id, model_variant, kernel_type_hint, epoch_duration_ms, kv_hit: true|false, kv_latency_ms (if measured), batch_wait_ms, gpu_compute_ms_estimate, worker_id.
- Tracing hooks: attach an optional short-lived span per "token epoch" that can be sampled (configurable rate) and enriched with cache flags and micro-timings.
- Metrics/log pipeline: add new proto schema for token_epoch events, ensure they flow through log-aggregation -> pre-aggregation (kafka) -> warehouse and traces.
- Dashboards: new Grafana panels that show token-level latency distributions, kv-hit-adjusted p50/p95 token cost, and request reconstitution charts (tokens over time with color-coded kv hits).
- Backwards compatibility: default to disabled sampling in prod; on rollout enable 0.1% sampling + deterministic on large requests (>2048 tokens) for debug mode.
- Privacy and cost controls: strip any token text from telemetry (only token index & byte-length), support KMS encryption for payloads in private deployments.

Non-goals:
- Per-customer billing finalization in this ticket (later integration with billing pipeline).
- Full per-token tokenization-aware attribution across all tokenizers; initial implementation supports BPE-style tokenizers and reports token_length bytes and token_position only.

Deliverables:
- Runtime patch with TEA hooks and feature flag + sampling control.
- Telemetry proto + log forwarder mapping.
- Grafana dashboard and dashboard-JSON export.
- End-to-end e2e test that asserts telemetry appears in staging pipeline and verifies kv hit vs miss paths.

Success metrics:
- TEA events emitted for >95% of instrumented requests in staging when sampling=100%.
- Mean additional latency per request due to TEA < 0.15ms at 0.1% sampling; overhead measured and documented.
- Dashboard surfaces clear kv-hit delta estimate and reduces investigation time for high-latency responses by 40% (measured via support ticket reduction).
acceptance_criteria: Runtime emits token_epoch events with required fields per spec when sampling enabled
Token_epoch proto validated and ingested into staging telemetry pipeline (kafka topic and consumer job)
Grafana panels show token-latency distributions and kv-hit delta charts for sample dataset
Automated e2e test exists that simulates cache-hit/miss paths and asserts event payloads
Performance regression benchmark demonstrating overhead at 0.1% and 100% sampling recorded in PR

comments: 2025-02-13: (Anika Patel) Drafted spec and proto schema. Reached out to infra to estimate Kafka topics and retention. Assigned to Liam for implementation.

2025-02-18: (Liam O'Connor) Spike complete: added span hooks in emission loop and measured naive overhead ~0.9ms at 100% sampling on a T4. Will optimize by avoiding allocations and deferring non-critical fields to async serializer.

2025-02-21: (Evelyn Zhao) Design review: +1 on schema. Asked to ensure token text never flows to logs by default. Also requested explicit field for sample_reason (random|large_request|force) to support deterministic capture for on-call debugging.
2025-02-28: (Liam O'Connor) Implemented async buffer + batching for proto flush to Kafka. Local microbench shows overhead ~0.12ms at 0.1% sampling, meets target. Pushed WIP PR for review.

2025-03-02: (Security) Quick review: KMS encryption for private deployments required. Added feature flag and updated proto to support encrypted_payload placeholder. Follow-up ticket created for KMS integration.
2025-03-05: (QA) Started staging ingestion test runs. Observed token_epoch events for both hit and miss flows; one schema mismatch fixed (kv_latency_ms sometimes null -> send -1).
